clips.title: The story
paras: This mission marks the conclusion of the Forsaken campaign against the human township of Hillsbrad. Having shattered the local Alliance forces, you are sent by High Executor Darthalia to present an official commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity.

The campaign in the Hillsbrad Foothills represents a brutal struggle for southern Lordaeron. Across a protracted series of strikes coordinated from Tarren Mill, Horde champions dismantled the human township's farmers, militia, blacksmiths, and civic leaders. With the Alliance presence crippled and the territory secured for the Forsaken, High Executor Darthalia drafts an official commendation to ensure the champion's exploits reach the highest ranks of command.

Carrying Darthalia's sealed commendation leads directly to the Royal Quarter of the Undercity, into the presence of Varimathras. Standing alongside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the dreadlord oversees military operations across Lordaeron. While the Scourge descending from the northern Plaguelands remains the Dark Lady's paramount existential threat, securing the southern borders against surviving human enclaves is vital for the nascent Forsaken nation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.
Take this sealed commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity. Go with pride, adventurer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What brings an adventurer all the way to the Undercity from the battlefield?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So you are the infamous adventurer who struck such a decisive blow against the Alliance forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills? Word of your glorious exploits traveled quickly to the Undercity.
You have quite a future in the Dark Lady's ranks if you continue to show such leadership and expertise in battle.

While our primary threat is the Lich King's Scourge army descending from the north, the human "problem" continues to impede our battle plans. You, however, have shown that the humans can and will fall.
